summary: Redesign performance reviews, feedback, and goal setting with practical tools, calibration methods, and manager-ready templates. Book the course.
lede: Performance management training helps HR professionals and managers redesign review cycles, goals, and feedback routines. It covers aligning OKRs and KPIs, coaching feedback, and calibrating evidence-based reviews with consistent criteria and documentation. Participants assess existing cycles, create development plans and calibration checklists, and prepare a practical implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, run, or improve performance management redesign in real organizations. It suits people who need stronger review cycles, clearer feedback routines, and better evidence for performance decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of HR processes, performance reviews, or people management; no coding required. You should be comfortable reading KPI reports, appraisal forms, and manager feedback records. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level, with limited conceptual introduction to AI-assisted analytics and digital workflow automation. Participants should bring laptop access for template editing and worksheet exercises, plus examples of current performance forms or review criteria if available.
